def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    nonbg = [v for v in set(vals) if v != bg]
    stripe = min(nonbg, key=lambda v: vals.count(v))
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (bg, stripe)]
    fill = grid[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]] if marks else bg
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Edge bars project inward along a line from the endpoint nearest the marks.
    for r in (0, h - 1):
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == stripe]
        if cols:
            c = min(cols, key=lambda x: min((abs(x-mc) for _, mc in marks), default=0))
            rs = range(1, h) if r == 0 else range(h - 1)
            for rr in rs:
                out[rr][c] = fill

    for c in (0, w - 1):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == stripe]
        if rows:
            r = min(rows, key=lambda x: min((abs(x-mr) for mr, _ in marks), default=0))
            cs = range(1, w) if c == 0 else range(w - 1)
            for cc in cs:
                out[r][cc] = fill

    for r, c in marks:
        out[r][c] = 4
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    # The sparse edge color forms bars; isolated cells are the ray color.
    edge = [grid[r][c] for r in (0, h-1) for c in range(w)
            if grid[r][c] != bg]
    bar = max(set(edge), key=edge.count)
    ray = next((v for v in set(vals) if v not in (bg, bar)), bg)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Project each edge bar inward along the perpendicular axis, using its
    # endpoint nearest the interior marks as the projection column/row.
    marks = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (bg, bar)]
    for r in (0, h-1):
        cs = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == bar]
        if cs:
            c = min(cs, key=lambda x: min((abs(x-mc) for _,mc in marks), default=0))
            for rr in (range(1,h) if r == 0 else range(h-1)):
                out[rr][c] = ray
    for c in (0, w-1):
        rs = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == bar]
        if rs:
            r = min(rs, key=lambda x: min((abs(x-mr) for mr,_ in marks), default=0))
            for cc in (range(1,w) if c == 0 else range(w-1)):
                out[r][cc] = ray

    # Marks are emphasized where their projected ray meets them.
    for r,c in marks:
        out[r][c] = 4
    return out
